subject: Post-call: Lumina onramp plan and decision path
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@luminahealth.com>, Brian O'Neill <b.oneill@medlytics.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap — onramp goals, risks, and proposed milestones

Thanks again for the demo time today — appreciated the candid run-through of the constraints at Lumina. Summary below so we’re aligned and can turn this into a short mutual action plan (MAP). Please flag corrections.

Pain points we heard
- Latency and reliability when processing EHR-derived text from three pilot sites (spikes during batch imports).
- Cost concerns for high-volume triage scoring (current vendor pricing model).
- Data isolation / PHI handling requirements for pilot (separate tenancy + audit logs).

Stated goals
- Pilot: automated triage scoring integrated into Lumina triage UI across 3 sites (~100k events/month).
- Performance targets: 95th percentile latency < 300ms for single-record inference, throughput target ~100 req/s with burst to 300.
- Compliance: SOC2 evidence + audit logging; key management integration.
- Decision target: executive sign-off + PO by 2026-05-01.

Proposed MAP (high level) — rough dates to confirm
1) Technical kickoff & data exchange checklist — target: 2026-02-22
   Owner: Lumina engineering (Alyssa) + Redwood solutions eng (Monica)
2) Integration POC (API + sample dataset, basic eval harness) — target: 2026-03-15
   Owner: Redwood eng + Lumina devs
3) Pilot evaluation (latency, throughput, cost / token economics, quality regressions) — target: 2026-04-15
   Owner: Lumina product + Redwood CS
4) Exec review & procurement (pricing + SOW final, DocuSign) — target: 2026-05-01
   Owner: Lumina execs + Lumina procurement (Jason)

Immediate asks / next steps
- Can you confirm stakeholders above (technical, procurement, compliance) and whether the dates look doable?
- If procurement needs standard terms earlier, include them now and we’ll surface SOW changes.

Attachments: [Attachment: MAP_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 240 KB)], [Attachment: SOW-draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 45 KB)]

Notes: I flagged potential mitigations for the data isolation ask (VPC + per-customer tenancy + limited retention) — happy to sketch in the kickoff.

Thanks — talk soon.

--
